# Funding

Funding refers to the amount of additional money a company needs to operate during a certain period of time. Some of the common funding options include investments such as debt financing, donations, equity, or traditional bank loans.

The business funding process aims to help companies achieve economic growth and is usually divided into three phases: pre-funding, funding, and post-funding.

news.raw_snippet: AI is going to make for amazing CEOs, provided they’re given the opportunity. That seems unlikely to happen, given the incentive structures at work. Nobody wants to put themselves out of a job, and the ruling class is promoting AI as it sees an opportunity to suppress white-collar wages. Advances in automation have largely pushed blue-collar workers out of a job over the past century, but putting white-collar workers in their place has proven more difficult. Thanks to AI, the CEO’s dream is [...] moving on to other sources. [...] Uber, for example, operated an illegal taxi business. Every major city in the country had laws that required drivers to be licensed to operate taxis. Unlicensed taxis were colloquially known as “gypsy cabs,” and you used to get in trouble for such things. But Uber slapped an app on top of a gypsy cab business and grew it quickly enough that local municipalities simply had to play ball and accept their existence.

 Cook said the iPhone maker plans to use AI as a selling point for iCloud subscriptions.
 "We do believe there will be people that want to use it a lot, and so we will have some kind of upgrade possibilities on on iCloud+," Cook said.

Tim Cook arriving at the annual Allen & Co. Media and Technology Conference in Sun Valley, Idaho on July 7th, 2026. [...] Cook, who will be assuming the role of executive chairman on Sept. 1, said Apple's hybrid approach to AI, where some workloads can be run on iPhones and Macs is an advantage as his large tech peers rely on their massive clouds.

It's an important signal to Wall Street about the company's ability to run AI apps as Apple gears up for the launch of an updated Siri this fall.
